title: A family tree
description:
Store people in a tree and answer questions with recursion.

```
Ada
  Bea
    Dan
    Eve
  Cal
    Fay
Generations: 3
Descendants of Bea: Dan, Eve
Common ancestor of Dan and Fay: Ada
```
hints: `height` is 1 plus the largest height of the children (1 for someone with no children) (lesson 5.05).
For the common ancestor, put every ancestor of `a` (including `a`) in a `Set`, then walk up from `b` until you meet one.
requirements: `class Person { String name; List<Person> children; Person parent; }` and an `addChild` that sets the parent.
`print(person, depth)` indents two spaces per generation.
`height(person)`, `descendants(person)` and `commonAncestor(a, b)` are recursive or walk the parent links.
stretch: Find cousins: people whose parents are siblings.
